name: EchoLeak
short_description: A zero-click prompt injection vulnerability in Microsoft 365 Copilot (CVE-2025-32711) in which a crafted email could cause Copilot to exfiltrate data; the episode describes it as an LLM scope violation.

evidence.quote: We've seen this play out with vulnerabilities like echo leak and reprompt.
Take a look at echo leak.
